workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Lists RACF certificates, keyrings and certificate chains for IZUSVR

variable.name: CERT_USERID
variable.label: Certificate User ID
variable.abstract: The user ID whose certificates will be listed
variable.description: The RACF user ID to list certificates for. Default is IZUSVR.

variable.name: CA_LABEL
variable.label: Certificate Authority Label
variable.abstract: Label of the CA certificate in CERTAUTH
variable.description: The label of the Certificate Authority certificate. Example: zOSMFCA

variable.name: KEYRING_LABEL
variable.label: KeyRing Label
variable.abstract: Name of the RACF keyring to list
variable.description: The keyring label associated with the user ID. Example: IZUKeyring.IZUDFLT

variable.name: CERT_LABEL
variable.label: Certificate Label
variable.abstract: Label of the certificate to list chain for
variable.description: The label of the certificate to list the chain for. Example: DefaultzOSMFCert.IZUDFLT

step.name: racdcertList
step.title: List RACF Certificates and KeyRings
step.description: Runs RACDCERT LIST, LISTRING and LISTCHAIN commands for the specified user ID via IKJEFT01
